task:
Draw: a snack stand front with a serving hatch, a sausage and a paper tray of chips painted on its board.
It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which every part of the district shares: A big-city quarter like Berlin: tall old town houses with stucco and balconies beside plain slab blocks of the sixties, pale plaster in cream, grey and washed-out pastel, posters and a little graffiti, tram wires, kiosks; busy, a bit rough, friendly..
